verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a bitmap image tool ('Convert, Edit, or Compose Bitmap Images'), so audio/video transcoding with codec and bitrate control is outside its product category. The mention of caching 'video, audio' is a storage feature, not transcoding. 'Motion picture support' covers image formats used in film work, not video codecs, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As a power user, audio and video transcode between formats with control over codec, bitrate, and resolution
